outcome: composite adverse perinatal outcomes (APO) (cesarean delivery, operative vaginal delivery due to pathological CTG, 5-min Apgar <7, umbilical artery pH <7.1, base excess >12 mmol/L, NICU admission)
objective adverse perinatal outcomes (APO) (excluding operative delivery for pathological CTG)
cohort: 395 healthy term pregnant women prior to labor onset, excluding those undergoing labor induction.
finding: Maternal systemic vascular resistance (SVR >1,135 dyn s cm-5), short-term variability (STV <=7 ms) from cCTG, and parity were identified as independent predictors of adverse perinatal outcomes (APO) in term pregnancies.
mod_finding: Predictors like SVR, STV, and parity were associated with a composite adverse perinatal outcome which included cesarean or operative vaginal delivery.
